name: clinical_v0_mask_key_component
rationale: Composed final-layer weights identify units 198 and 38 as positive readout paths that activate for high normalized values. In 128 calibration patients, their active cases remain underestimated after the original affine correction; almost all are measured variables rather than static/administrative channels. Increase only these two effective output coefficients by 1%, a fixed conservative expansion of the existing learned paths. Negative GELU-tail contributions change in the opposite direction, also consistent with the common positive offset in the low/middle range. No fitting, gradients, optimizer or test data. Counterfactual forward passes through the conditioning input projection and LayerNorm, toggling only the supplied mask and keeping interpolated values fixed, identify a consistent availability direction (median cosine alignment 0.902). Spatial attention head 7 has the strongest observed-source preference. Increase only its existing key projection along this direction by 10%, leaving orthogonal key features and all query/value weights unchanged. A small-layer forward probe increased its observed-source mass from 0.29746 to 0.29798. Responses vary across queries, so this is a specific hypothesis requiring full imputation checks, not a guaranteed correction. No target values, gradients, fitting, optimizer, parameter sweep or test data determine the edit.
